rule: Make the invite page look like this: Hey, can you make our invite page look like this? A solid purple bar across the top with our logo and name in white, then a very pale lavender page underneath with a big bold dark purple heading and one short line under it. In the middle I want a big white card with really round corners and a soft purple glow around it, with the offer in large bold hot pink text and a small purple line under it. Below that, a rounded purple pill button with white text, and under the button a short numbered list of three steps in purple. Plenty of empty space, nothing else on the page.
